scenes.title: One order. Clear ownership.
scenes.event: One persisted order identity / no live network provisioning

panels.label: START
panels.text: An Istanbul business orders dedicated Internet.

panels.label: OWNER
panels.text: The customer supplies intent; the supervisor sequences bounded agents.

panels.label: CONTROL
panels.text: Every transition is persisted and audited.

panels.label: READ THIS FILM
panels.text: Green paths are implemented. Amber production gates are not demo features.

beats.text: An Istanbul business needs connectivity. Follow one order, with clear owners, explicit exceptions, and human decisions.
This is a simulator. Amber production paths are proposals, not implemented features.

events: One persisted order identity / no live network provisioning

scenes.title: Accept once. Never lose the handoff.

panels.label: DO
panels.text: Accept approved catalogue, city and synthetic customer fields.

panels.label: OUTPUT
panels.text: Persist order and event together, using one stable identifier.

panels.label: EXCEPTION
panels.text: Reject invalid fields or a reused key with changed content.

panels.label: HUMAN
panels.text: The submitter corrects the request and resubmits.

panels.label: IMPACT
panels.text: Avoid duplicate orders and lost manual handoffs.

beats.text: Intake persists the order and event together. A stable key prevents duplicate work.
Invalid requests return to the submitter, not downstream agents.

events: Product order + idempotency key -> order.received
Product order + idempotency key -> order.received

scenes.title: Stop bad input before it becomes fallout.

panels.label: DO
panels.text: Check service-site reference and available capacity.

panels.label: OUTPUT
panels.text: Validated intent, ready for decomposition.

panels.label: EXCEPTION
panels.text: Wrong site: await confirmation. No capacity: stop for review.

panels.label: HUMAN
panels.text: Submitter confirms the customer's site; manager resolves inventory or rejects.

panels.label: IMPACT
panels.text: Catch mismatches early, before planning or allocation.

beats.text: Validation checks the site and capacity before planning. Bad references stop for customer confirmation.
No capacity means manager review or rejection. Approval cannot invent inventory.

events: order.received -> feasibility check -> order.validated
order.received -> feasibility check -> order.validated

scenes.title: One intent becomes linked work orders.
scenes.event: order.validated -> linked service + resource orders -> services.planned

panels.label: DO
panels.text: Expand approved catalogue mappings into services and resources.

panels.label: OUTPUT
panels.text: Linked work orders retain the product-order identifier.

panels.label: EXCEPTION
panels.text: Unsupported product is rejected at intake; no invented plan.

panels.label: HUMAN / PRODUCTION GATE
panels.text: A planner defines and approves new catalogue mappings.

panels.label: IMPACT
panels.text: Reduce rekeying and mismatched service/resource references.

beats.text: Decomposition converts approved products into linked service and resource orders, reducing rekeying errors.
Unsupported products are rejected at intake. Production planners must approve new catalogue mappings.

events: order.validated -> linked service + resource orders -> services.planned
order.validated -> linked service + resource orders -> services.planned

scenes.title: Allocate once. Respect the authority boundary.

panels.label: DO
panels.text: Recheck capacity and policy, then allocate once and activate.

panels.label: OUTPUT
panels.text: Completed services/resources and services.activated.

panels.label: EXCEPTION
panels.text: Timeout -> recovery. Risk or closed window -> manager hold.

panels.label: HUMAN
panels.text: Manager approves bounded risk/window decisions or rejects.

panels.label: IMPACT
panels.text: Avoid duplicate allocation and unsafe changes.

beats.text: Provisioning rechecks capacity and policy, then allocates once. A timeout activates recovery.
Route risk or a closed change window stops before allocation, for a manager decision.

events: services.planned -> policy gates -> simulated activation
services.planned -> policy gates -> simulated activation

scenes.title: Recover the known fault. Never loop blindly.

panels.label: DO
panels.text: Handle the allowlisted partner timeout with one simulated retry.

panels.label: OUTPUT
panels.text: Alternate simulated route; return to provisioning.

panels.label: EXCEPTION / PRODUCTION GATE
panels.text: Other faults or exhausted retries -> manual triage.

panels.label: HUMAN / PRODUCTION GATE
panels.text: Service manager authorizes remediation outside the playbook.

panels.label: IMPACT
panels.text: Reduce recoverable waiting without unlimited retry storms.

beats.text: Recovery handles one allowlisted partner timeout, retries once, and returns to provisioning.
Unknown faults or exhausted retries need a proposed human triage path, not broader autonomous authority.

events: fallout.detected -> retry once -> fallout.recovered -> provisioning
fallout.detected -> retry once -> fallout.recovered -> provisioning

scenes.title: The manager decides. The agent cannot overrule.
scenes.event: Held order -> audited approve/reject -> bounded resume or stop

panels.label: REVIEW
panels.text: Route conflict, closed window, capacity shortage or breached demo SLA.

panels.label: DECISION
panels.text: Approve within permitted scope, or reject with an audit record.

panels.label: LIMIT
panels.text: No fabricated capacity. A partner cannot approve.

panels.label: RETURN
panels.text: Resume the saved stage; never restart the entire order.

beats.text: The service manager owns high-risk decisions. Approval is audited, bounded, and cannot fabricate capacity.
Approved work resumes its saved stage. Partners cannot approve.

events: Held order -> audited approve/reject -> bounded resume or stop
Held order -> audited approve/reject -> bounded resume or stop

scenes.title: Communicate the actual state, not false success.
scenes.event: services.activated -> persisted TR/EN portal update -> completed

panels.label: DO
panels.text: Persist Turkish and English updates after simulated activation.

panels.label: OUTPUT
panels.text: Customer-visible portal status and completed order.

panels.label: EXCEPTION / PRODUCTION GATE
panels.text: External delivery failure -> service-desk incident.

panels.label: HUMAN / PRODUCTION GATE
panels.text: Service desk confirms the customer received the update.

panels.label: IMPACT
panels.text: Clear status can reduce chasing and repeated handoffs.

beats.text: Customer updates persist bilingual portal status after activation, reducing avoidable chasing.
External delivery failure needs a proposed service-desk path. This demo sends no SMS or email.

events: services.activated -> persisted TR/EN portal update -> completed
services.activated -> persisted TR/EN portal update -> completed

scenes.chapter: 08 / Why fallout and delivery time can fall
scenes.title: Mechanisms first. Outcomes must be measured.
scenes.event: Prevent errors + remove rekeying + shorten recoverable waits

panels.label: LESS FALLOUT
panels.text: Early validation + linked IDs + allocate-once guards prevent avoidable rework.

panels.label: SHORTER DELIVERY
panels.text: Persisted handoffs + catalogue plans + bounded recovery reduce queue dwell.

panels.label: ASSIGNMENT TARGETS / NOT RESULTS
panels.text: 35 days -> under 7. Fallout 30% -> under 8%.

panels.label: PILOT EVIDENCE
panels.text: Measure lead time, first-time-right completion, recovery and human-review waiting.

beats.text: Early checks prevent downstream errors. Linked identifiers remove rekeying. Persisted handoffs and bounded recovery reduce waiting.
Under seven days and eight percent fallout are targets, not results. Measure lead time, first-time-right completion, and human-review waiting.

events: Prevent errors + remove rekeying + shorten recoverable waits
Prevent errors + remove rekeying + shorten recoverable waits

scenes.title: Interoperate without exporting customer data.
scenes.event: TMF-inspired interfaces + local workload + individually approved cloud flows

panels.label: STANDARDS
panels.text: TMF622/TMF641-inspired subsets; MCP intake. Not full certification.

panels.label: TURKIYE / AZURE LOCAL
panels.text: Customer data, workflow, inference, keys, raw logs and backups stay local.

panels.label: OUTSIDE / APPROVAL REQUIRED
panels.text: Azure images, Arc metadata and safe monitoring aggregates only.

panels.label: STRICTER BOUNDARY
panels.text: If metadata cannot leave: assess eligible disconnected operation.

beats.text: TMF-inspired interfaces and MCP preserve interoperability. The proposed Azure Local workload keeps customer data in Turkiye.
External metadata and services need approval. Stricter rules require eligible disconnected operation, not a live cloud link.
